lesson: The owner's check brief listed promises but did not say what had not been tested.
The coder left a debug print statement in the file it handed back.
The brief to the checker gave no list of untested areas, so the checker spent a round finding them.
The checker ran the verify command before reading any code, which caught a red build early.
A leftover debug print from the coder reached the owner's diff review.
The owner wrote the spec from a description in two lines and started without asking, as the role says.
What was not tested was missing from the owner's check brief again; the checker blocked on an untested path.
The coder's result again included a debug print the task did not ask for.
The auditor's report compared STATE.md with the code and found one stale line.
